run_builtin_converter_tests: run the doctest suite for Boost.Python builtin type converters using the run function
test_integer_overflow_handling: test overflow behavior of signed and unsigned integer converters like rewrap_value_int and rewrap_value_long
test_float_converter_identity: test that float double and long double converters return identity values via rewrap_value_float
test_string_converter_wrapping: test cstring string and wstring value wrapping with embedded nulls and unicode via rewrap_value_string
test_bool_char_converter_behavior: test bool and char value conversion including silent truncation of multi-char strings via rewrap_value_bool
